name: Isabel Costa
bio:
Isabel Costa's journey in motorsport began in her late twenties, fueled by a lifelong fascination with engineering and a chance encounter with a local karting team struggling with their technical setup. Her knack for problem-solving and strategic thinking quickly made her indispensable, and she soon found herself deeply involved in the technical aspects of the sport. Over the years, she honed her skills, working her way up through various teams and disciplines, always with a keen eye for detail and a relentless pursuit of improvement.

As a Sporting Director, Isabel is known for her pragmatic yet innovative approach. She believes in empowering her team, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and heard. Her strength lies in her ability to identify and nurture talent, both on and off the track, ensuring that the team has the right people in the right roles. What sets Isabel apart is her unwavering commitment to fair play and ethical conduct, earning her respect and admiration throughout the paddock. She focuses on creating a sustainable, long-term competitive advantage, rather than chasing short-term gains.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Isabel has a warm smile and a focused gaze, conveying both competence and approachability.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and notes.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters in her office.
Insists on a daily 15-minute walk, rain or shine, to clear her head.
